title: Credentialing & Health Insurance Specialist
description:

Patients instantly access an ER Telehealth Provider and a Patient Navigator who provide a trusted, genuine human connection in a time of need. The Credentialing and Health Insurance Specialist will be responsible for managing all aspects of the provider licensing and credentialing process including health plan network participation across multiple states. This dynamic role requires a strong understanding of licensing and credentialing, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with other departments. As a crucial member of our team, you will leverage your expertise to optimize revenue cycles, ensure compliance with state and federal regulations, and contribute to the financial health of our organization. Your skills in navigating complex state and federal licensing systems and health plan network systems will be instrumental in maintaining smooth operations.
If you would like the opportunity to make a tangible impact on community health while working for a dynamic, mission-driven organization, we would love to hear from you!

• Strong knowledge of licensing, credentialing, Medicare and Medicaid

Provider Licensure/Credentialing: Comprehensive knowledge of licensure and credentialing and ability to apply that knowledge to multiple states and provider types. This includes understanding various external regulatory systems, State and Federal requirements, and regulatory compliance.
Attention to Detail: Meticulous focus on accuracy when handling provider information, licensure data, and records. This skill is crucial for minimizing errors in licensure and ensuring proper care given to a provider's personal data.
Problem Solving Skills: Ability to analyze complex licensure issues, identify discrepancies, and develop effective solutions. This competency is essential for resolving licensure and credentialing discrepancy, health plan network processes and optimizing revenue by facilitating timely ability to bill for provider services.
Communication: Proficiency in clearly conveying complex licensure/credentialing issues to Operations to include timely notification of effective dates. An important component is the ability to clearly convey the RightSite model to facilitate obtaining FFS contracts.

title: Order Processing Specialist (English required)
Expert Audio Transcriber, Persian
description:
ABOUT PERLE
Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises. Our partners include xAI, Samsung, ELM, and Unisys. Headquartered in San Francisco with experts across more than forty markets, we specialize in the work that requires real human judgment: domain expertise, linguistic nuance, and cultural fidelity that generic data vendors cannot deliver.
Apply here:
THE ROLE
We are hiring expert Persian transcribers to convert audio recordings of native speakers into precise, conventionally formatted written transcripts. The work powers speech recognition, dialogue, and evaluation systems for major AI labs. Audio ranges from clean studio recordings to natural conversational speech in real-world acoustic conditions.
You will be working at the level of expert linguistic judgment. This is not data entry. Decisions about orthography, code-switching, speaker attribution, disfluencies, and non-speech events shape the quality of every model trained on your output.
DIALECT AND SCOPE
Persian (Farsi) as spoken in Iran, with awareness of related Dari (Afghanistan) and Tajik varieties where they appear. Project audio reflects everyday Iranian Persian speech with regional variation.
Primary speaker regions: Tehran, Isfahan, Mashhad, Shiraz, Tabriz, Qom.
WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Transcribe audio recordings into accurate, time-aligned written text following Perle's project-specific style guide

• Apply correct conventions for speaker identification, overlapping speech, disfluencies, fillers, false starts, and non-speech events such as laughter, background noise, and music

• Make principled orthographic decisions for dialectal, colloquial, and code-switched speech

• Flag ambiguous segments, uncertain speakers, and audio quality issues using project conventions

• Self-review every submission against Perle's quality bar before delivery

• Engage with QA reviewers on edge cases, calibration sessions, and style guide updates

MUST HAVE

• Native fluency in Iranian Persian with lifelong residence or deep immersion in Iran

• High accuracy reading and writing in Perso-Arabic script

• Ability to distinguish Iranian Persian from Dari and Tajik in mixed audio

• Familiarity with Arabic loanword conventions and Persian colloquial speech

• At least two years of professional transcription, captioning, court reporting, broadcast, translation, or linguistic annotation experience

• Demonstrated accuracy at the word level under deadline pressure

• Comfortable with web-based annotation platforms and variable-speed audio playback

• Reliable high-speed internet, quality headphones, and a quiet workspace

• Ability to commit to defined volume per week during active project phases

NICE TO HAVE

• Background in Iranian linguistics, translation, journalism, or media

• Prior experience annotating Persian-variety speech data

• Working knowledge of Arabic, Dari, or Tajik for cross-lingual audio

• Familiarity with IPA or other phonetic transcription systems

• Experience with verbatim versus clean-verbatim transcription conventions

HOW WE WORK WITH YOU

• Paid pilot task before full onboarding so both sides can calibrate

• Per-task or per-minute compensation, with rates tied to audio complexity and turnaround

• Flexible scheduling, with volume scaling up and down based on active client projects

• Direct working relationship with Perle's linguistic leads and QA team

• Eligible for invitation to additional Perle expert projects across related domains

HOW TO APPLY
Apply through Winnow, Perle's job portal at winnow.perle.ai. Find the role for your language under Open Jobs, set up your candidate profile, and complete the fully automated interview, which takes about 25 minutes. We review applications within 24 hours and invite passing candidates straight to the project.

title: Internship - Foundational Research Scientist
description:
Smule has been on a mission to bring the world together through music since 2008. Music is much more than listening… it's about creating, sharing, discovering, participating, and connecting with people. With dozens of millions of monthly active users creating over 20 million songs every day, Smule is connecting people all over the world through the joy of making music and transforming the music landscape from one of passive listening to collaborative creative expression and active engagement.
About the Role:
We are looking for a Research Scientist to join Smule's Foundational Research team. In this role you will pursue long-horizon research questions that advance the state of the art in sequence modeling, generative modeling, and representation learning, with a particular focus on architectures and methods relevant to audio and music. You will design and execute rigorous experiments, publish at top venues, and contribute novel ideas that shape the direction of Smule's research agenda. The ideal candidate is deeply curious, comfortable with open-ended exploration, and motivated by scientific contribution.
We strongly encourage candidates with non-traditional ML backgrounds to apply. If your path into machine learning research came through physics, mathematics, signal processing, music technology, neuroscience, or another field, we want to hear from you.
What You'll Be Doing:

• Identify, scope, and lead independent research projects that push the boundaries of current understanding in areas such as efficient sequence modeling, generative audio, representation learning, and optimization.

• Design experiments with rigorous controls, ablation studies, and statistical analysis to validate hypotheses.

• Publish findings at top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, Interspeech, ISMIR, or equivalent) and contribute to the broader research community through open-source artifacts and talks.

• Collaborate with applied research and engineering teams to translate foundational insights into practical improvements for Smule's products.

• Stay current with the latest literature, synthesize relevant work, and identify high-leverage research directions for the team.

• Mentor junior researchers and interns, fostering a culture of intellectual rigor and creative exploration.

What We're Looking For:

• Degree (B.S., M.S., or Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or currently pursuing one.

• Strong publication record at top ML/AI venues demonstrating original contributions.

• Deep expertise in at least one core area: sequence modeling, generative models, optimization, probabilistic methods, or representation learning.

• Proficiency in Python and modern deep learning frameworks (PyTorch preferred).

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to present complex ideas clearly to diverse audiences.

• Demonstrated ability to independently scope, execute, and communicate a research project from idea to publication.

Bonus Points For:

• Experience with audio, speech, or music signal processing and modeling.

• Familiarity with linear attention mechanisms, state-space models, or efficient transformer variants.

• Experience with large-scale distributed training and high-performance computing.

• Track record of successful cross-functional collaboration with engineering teams.

Smule is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under federal, state, or local law.
We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

title: RISE Course Instructor
description:
Overview
OVERVIEW
Illinois Mathematics and Science Academy (IMSA) is seeking an instructor for its online, year-long RISE (Research, Inquiry Skills and Experimentation) course for students in grades 9-12. The course instructor guides RISE students through a series of 13 on-line learning modules where students learn how to find a testable question, create a student research plan, and conduct an in-depth study of a science topic of their choice. This course gives students the opportunity to participate in the community of scientific research and scholarship. Students are expected to utilize their work from this program to enter various science symposia.
This is a part-time, 10-month, exempt position. This position will be completed remotely and the course is mostly asynchronous. Expected hours will vary by the number of enrolled students, but typically be 15-20 hours/week for a cohort of approximately 20 students. This position will begin in August 2026, with the actual course beginning in September. Courses run from late September through the end of May each year.
The Illinois Mathematics and Science Academy (IMSA) is committed to an equitable, diverse and inclusive teaching and learning environment. Through a model of Equity and Excellence, IMSA has committed to advancing equity in STEM education and representation and creating a diverse, inclusive community of global citizens who can realize their full potential, and execute our mission to advance the human condition.
This Equity and Excellence Model is the intentional integration of Cultural Competence, Diversity, Equity, Equity-Minded Frame, Excellence and Inclusion into every facet of the Academy, with the understanding that it is an active and ongoing process involving structures, processes and people and not an isolated initiative.
Responsibilities
RESPONSIBILITIES
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable Accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. This individual will be responsible for:

• Guiding and mentoring a group of high school students through a series of online learning modules

• Teaching students how to conduct independent research and accurately report and communicate their findings.

• Utilizing the Canvas learning management system

• Teaching a diverse group of students in a multidisciplinary environment

• Using evolving technological tools to engage students in a virtual classroom

• Attending the annual conference that RISE students submit their work to, as well as, any other symposia where the course instructor’s attendance may be needed.

Qualifications
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

• Master’s degree in education with at least 5 years of relevant science experience at the secondary level.

• Broad content background in science

• Working understanding of the research process

• Deep understanding of how to effectively communicate with students via a virtual learning environment

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills

WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:
Work will be performed remotely. Substantial time is spent working on a computer. This role generally requires, written and verbal communication, and hearing and visual capabilities. However, reasonable accommodations, including assistive technology, may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform such requirements.
COMPENSATION:
This position is a part-time, non- exempt, 10-month, employment-at-will position. Compensation is $48.00/hr. This position is not benefits eligible

title: Head of Market Surveillance
description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 - connecting users to the future of digital finance.

 

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

 

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

 

 

About the Role

 

We are looking for Head of Market Surveillance to build and lead our trading risk control function. You will own the end-to-end framework that protects our platform and users from market manipulation, abnormal trading behavior, and systemic risk - spanning Spot, Derivatives (Futures & Options), Copy Trading, and Institutional products.

 

 

Key Responsibilities

 

1. Framework & Strategy

 

•
Design and implement the overarching market surveillance architecture, including policies, procedures, and governance frameworks.

•
Develop short- and long-term roadmaps for surveillance capabilities aligned with business growth and regulatory evolution.

•
Establish a full-lifecycle risk control system to proactively identify and mitigate user-behavior-driven risks before they materialize into losses or complaints.

 

2. Cross-Product Risk Governance

 

•
Own surveillance coverage across Spot, Futures, Options, Copy Trading, and Institutional/OTC product lines.

•
Detect and mitigate market manipulation (wash trading, spoofing/layering, pump-and-dump, front-running, etc.), abnormal trading patterns, and whale-concentration risks.

•
Define alert thresholds, escalation protocols, and enforcement actions (warnings, restrictions, liquidation safeguards).

 

3. Strategy Development & Intelligence

 

•
Build and continuously refine quantitative detection models and rule engines for manipulation identification and real-time intervention.

•
Leverage data analytics and machine learning to improve detection precision and reduce false positives.

•
Stay current on emerging manipulation tactics in crypto markets and adapt surveillance strategies accordingly.

 

4. Team Leadership

 

•
Recruit, develop, and performance-manage a high-caliber surveillance team (analysts, quant developers, investigators).

•
Drive the team toward standardization, automation, and intelligent (AI-assisted) operations.

•
Foster a culture of continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and cross-functional collaboration with Compliance, Legal, Product, and Engineering.

 

Requirements

 

Must-Have

 

•
Master's degree or above in Finance, Computer Science, Statistics, or related quantitative field.

•
3+ years of market surveillance / trading risk control experience at a top-tier centralized exchange (CEX) or equivalent financial institution.

•
Deep familiarity with CEX product mechanics and the risk scenarios that lead to customer disputes or financial losses.

•
Strong understanding of common market manipulation typologies and detection methodologies; able to articulate a personal surveillance philosophy.

•
Hands-on capability in strategy/rule development and data analys

title: Senior Data Scientist
salary: $250K – $300K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus • up to 40% annual performance bonus; paid up to 10% quarterly
description:
Confido is the AI infrastructure powering modern CPG - the platform that 200+ brands like OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Dr. Squatch, and Tropicana use to run everything from deductions to production planning. Finance, accounting, sales, and operations, unified in one system for the first time.

We're growing 5x year over year with a small team in New York City; the people who join now will shape the product, the culture, and the company itself.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere - and outsized ownership while you build - we'd love to meet you.

THE ROLE

CPG brands live and die by their ability to predict what’s coming - how much product will sell, where demand will land, and what a promotion will actually do to the business. At Confido, you’ll build models that help brands forecast sales, price products, and shape promotional strategy. You’ll work with an unusually broad dataset spanning sell-through, inventory, deductions, trade promotions, and supply-chain signals from 200+ brands - much of it messy, real-world data that makes the problems genuinely interesting. The models you build will directly influence decisions behind the products you see on store shelves every day.

As a Data Scientist, you'll turn that data into models and analyses that ship inside the product - not slide decks. You'll work alongside our AI/ML engineering team to move from exploratory analysis to production-grade insight.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

- Demand and sales forecasting - improving prediction quality across thousands of noisy, real-world retail time series

- Promotion effectiveness - measuring lift, price elasticity, and cannibalization so brands know which promotions actually pay

- Data quality and evaluation - building the statistical checks that keep our models honest as messy data flows in

ABOUT YOU

- 5+ years of hands-on data science experience with real-world (not benchmark) data

- Strong statistical foundations: regression, time-series methods, experiment design, uncertainty quantification

- Fluent in Python and SQL; comfortable working in a modern data stack (we use Snowflake and dbt)

- You care whether your analysis is right, not just whether it runs - you validate, sanity-check, and communicate uncertainty

- You can explain a model to a non-technical brand operator and defend it to an ML engineer

BONUS

- Experience with retail, CPG, supply chain, or demand-planning data

- Experience shipping models into production systems (vs. offline analysis only)

- Familiarity with forecasting at scale (hierarchical forecasting, intermittent demand)

Stack: Python · SQL · Snowflake · dbt · AWS

🌴 PERKS + BENEFITS

- Equity - own a meaningful piece of the company you’re helping build

- Fully paid health coverage through Aetna - we cover 100% of employee premiums

- Top-tier dental and vision coverage through Guardian

- 12 weeks of paid parental leave

- Unlimited PTO - plus regular 4-day holiday weekends we actually take

- 401(k) through Vestwell

- Paid relocation support - we’ll help you make the move to NYC

- Fully equipped workspace from day one - laptop, monitor, keyboard, and a $200 stipend to personalize your setup

- Team perks - catered Friday lunches, team dinners, and unlimited coffee + snacks featuring products from the brands we work with

DEIN TRAININGSZIEL FÜR DIE ERSTEN 6 MONATE

- HRIS-Implementierung: Du hast einen Projektplan mit definierten Meilensteinen und einen Plan für die Datenmigration erarbeitet

- Prozessoptimierung: Du verstehst unsere aktuelle HR-Datenlandschaft, hast Datenlücken und Systemverbesserungen identifizierst und erste Optimierungen angestoße

Senior Operations Associate Job Announcement

Heartland Fund is seeking a Senior Operations Associate. For a thoughtful, mission-driven professional, this position is an exciting opportunity to support new systems and processes in a rapidly growing grantmaking organization and ever changing compliance environment.

Heartland Fund’s Senior Operations Associate plays a central role in keeping our organization running smoothly, weaving together board and governance support, internal communications, leadership team coordination, and day-to-day operational backbone. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactively anticipates needs, and exercises excellent judgment in a fast-paced environment.

You will have an opportunity to help us enable equitable investment in rural communities, democracy, and climate solutions. This is a unique and dynamic position with opportunities for growth and impact as the Heartland Fund prepares to launch as an independent entity in 2027.

This is a remote position within the US. The starting salary range is $75,650 - $89,000. This position includes a generous benefits package.

About the Organization

As a funder collaborative, the Heartland Fund scales investment, supports local leaders, and builds long-term partnerships with rural and Native organizations to create thriving places where rural working people can determine our own futures, strengthening the entire nation. Heartland's grantmaking and programmatic investments support rural people working to transform their lives and communities toward shared prosperity, a healthy climate, and stronger democracy. We invest in building local capacity for issue advocacy, community organizing, economic development and local jobs, climate solutions, civic engagement, and sustainable urban-rural coalitions. We prioritize racial justice in all aspects of our work. In addition to grantmaking, Heartland also supports rural leaders and organizations through convening, research, and communications and storytelling.

Heartland Fund has three programs:

• Rural Democracy expands nonpartisan civic participation and counters policies that harm our democratic institutions in places where rural action can define policy and democratic outcomes.

• Resource Rural (RR) mobilizes resources enabling rural communities to unlock public and private investment to create positive economic change in their communities.

• Rural Climate Partnership (RCP) supports hometowns across America to accelerate climate solutions and build healthy local economies.

Both RR and RCP programs help rural communities access public funding - through place-based technical assistance, local organizing, and a large-scale communications and narrative effort - to make a tangible difference in rural people’s lives and to advance climate mitigation and resilience.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

The Senior Operations Associate reports to the Senior Director of Finance & Operations and works closely with members of the leadership team to support the Governance and Management functions of the organization. This role is responsible for scheduling, logistics, communications and administrative support for the board, board committees and the leadership team.

Board & Committee Support

description:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

Vanta's Governance and Compliance platform is the operating layer enterprises trust to run their security programs. We are hiring an engineer who will own the architectural foundation that makes it work for their most complex organizational structures.

Program Structure and Trust is a newly chartered group at Vanta with a focused mission: build the enterprise org model that lets customers bring their compliance and security structure - product lines, business units, isolated data environments, cross-cutting audits, scoped approvals, and data residency requirements - natively into the platform. The problems this team solves determine whether Vanta can serve the enterprise customers it's increasingly winning.

This is the defining technical role of the group. The Principal Engineer owns the design, phased delivery, and long-term technical direction of Vanta's enterprise org model - a multi-quarter initiative that cuts across the platform and establishes the foundation for how enterprise customers structure, segment, and operate inside Vanta.

Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog https://www.vanta.com/all-categories/engineering to learn more about what our team is working on! 

What you’ll do as a Principal Engineer at Vanta:

- Own the design and multi-quarter delivery of Vanta's enterprise org model, including hierarchical product lines and business units, isolated data access and ownership, cross-cutting audit workflows, scoped approvals, and EU and GovCloud data residency support

- Define and evolve the core abstractions that let the platform absorb structurally diverse, often conflicting enterprise requirements - solving for the general case rather than one-off customer accommodations

- Retrofit a live production system toward a multi-tenant org structure: design safe migration paths, sequence delivery incrementally, and preserve continuity for existing customers as the architecture evolves

- Carve out and ship meaningful customer value each quarter while progressing toward the full solution - this requires product judgment, direct engagement with enterprise customers, and the discipline to draw clean increment lines through a complex problem space

- Drive execution across squads outside your direct area, building alignment through technical clarity and credibility rather than authority

- Partner with Engineering leadership, Product, and Design to translate the long-term vision for enterprise structure into phased, deliverable work

- Set the technical standard for the group - define patterns others build to, shape architecture across teams, and model the engineering excellence the Program Structure and Trust charter is organized around

How to be successful in this role:

- 15+ years of deep backend engineering experience with a track record of leading complex, multi-quarter technical initiatives in fast-paced, product-focused environments

- Designed platform abstractions that absorbed messy, conflicting enterprise requirements across a diverse customer base - you've solved for the general case, not the loudest customer request

- A track record of shipping in stages: you've moved large, structurally complex problems forward incrementally, with each phase standing on its own, without getting ahead of what customers and the product can absorb

- A history of operating effectively across squads and teams you don't own - alignment built through technical clarity and credibility, not org chart proximity

- Deep familiarity with enterprise architectural patterns: tenancy models, role-based access control, data isolation, scoped permissions, cross-tenant operations, and access boundary

That means onboarding them properly, keeping high-value accounts healthy, and turning churn from something we observe into something we manage. You will build the function itself (playbooks, health scoring, reporting) rather than inherit it.
One thing worth stating openly before you apply: the workload is around 50 hours a week for the first 6 to 9 months while the function is being built. We would rather you decline now than discover it in month two.
Key responsibilities
Onboarding and activation

• Own the onboarding of new buyers end to end, from first purchase to first repeat purchase.

• Run onboarding calls and follow-ups, making sure every new buyer understands how to filter, buy, and work leads effectively.

• Design and maintain the onboarding sequence (content, timing, channel) and improve it based on what actually converts.

Account health and retention

• Manage a book of high-value accounts with regular check-ins, usage reviews, and proactive outreach.

• Build and maintain a health-scoring model that flags at-risk accounts before they churn, not after.

• Run save conversations on at-risk accounts and document what worked, by reason code.

Escalations and problem-solving

• Act as the escalation point for buyer complaints, including lead quality disputes, refund requests, and billing or balance issues.

• Coordinate with support, sales, and engineering to resolve issues, and follow through until the customer confirms resolution.

• Operate within agreed refund and credit authority limits, and defend those decisions with data.

Voice of the customer

• Collect, categorise, and quantify churn and refund reasons, turning anecdotes into a ranked list.

• Deliver a weekly written report to product and leadership on retention performance and the top issues driving cancellations.

• Advocate for the product changes that would remove recurring causes of churn.

Process and reporting

• Build the Customer Success playbooks from scratch: onboarding, save, win-back, and escalation.

• Maintain accurate account records and interaction history in our systems.

• Report on retention metrics weekly, and own the definitions behind them.

Collaboration

• Work daily with sales on the handoff of new buyers, and with support on ticket patterns.

• Partner with product and analytics on lifecycle experiments and instrumentation.

Requirements

• 2+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or Retention in a high-volume, low-ACV environment such as a marketplace, self-serve SaaS, or transactional product with hundreds of accounts. (Enterprise CSM experience with a handful of large logos is a different job and will not transfer well here.)

• Demonstrated ownership of a retention, churn, or repeat-purchase metric. You can describe what it was, what you changed, and what it became.

• Comfortable working with data: SQL basics or strong BI fluency (Amplitude, Metabase, Looker, BigQuery, or similar). You pull your own numbers rather than requesting them.

• Experience building a process from zero, such as an onboarding flow, a save playbook, or a health-score model. Executing someone else's process is not the same thing.

• Written and spoken English at C1 level, customer-facing, at volume.

• Confident on the phone with US small-business customers. Our buyers are real

FirstPrinciples is building AI to accelerate scientific discovery. Our core product is the Theo Platform, a research environment built to help researchers iterate faster, validate rigorously, and reach verified results they can trust.

 

We're a fast-growing, remote-first team of builders, researchers, engineers, and thinkers working across Canada, the US, the UK, and expanding globally. What brings us together is a shared curiosity about how the universe works, and a belief that we can build systems that help us explore it more effectively.

 

We spend our time working on questions that don't have clear answers, like how to design AI that can reason through scientific problems, and how the scientific process as a whole might evolve. This is work that sits somewhere between creativity and rigorous thinking, and often requires comfort with ambiguity and iteration. If you're someone who enjoys tackling big, abstract problems and exploring ideas that don't yet have a defined path forward, you'll likely find the work here interesting.

Why This Role Exists:

FirstPrinciples is looking for a driven and experienced product manager to join our team. In this role, you will play a key, cross-functional role helping shape the vision, development, and growth of our products.

Building at the cutting-edge of AI and science, this role is a rare, rewarding opportunity to build for the unique and complex requirements of the spaces we operate in. The ideal candidate has a proven track record in product management who can combine strategic thinking with enough technical depth to guide our efforts and bring complex ideas to life.

What You’ll Do:

- Work closely with FirstPrinciples leadership to ensure the product vision addresses research challenges and supports scientific advancement.

- Continuously improve and iterate your product portfolio, deeply owning the vision, strategy, and roadmap of your products.

- Maintain consistent communication across the organization to ensure transparency and alignment.

- Uphold operational excellence through documentation, cross-team alignment, and strong execution rituals.

- Product Management: Deep understanding of modern product management craft and theory, as well as practical experience applying it.

- Organizational & Planning Skills: Demonstrated ability to plan product roadmaps, prioritize features, and manage releases.

- Technical Aptitude: Familiarity with software development processes, best practices, AI/ML concepts, and data infrastructure.

What You’ll Get:

- The opportunity to work on foundational problems at the intersection of AI and physics

- A high-trust, low-bureaucracy environment with real ownership

- Remote-first work with flexibility in how you structure your day

- Exposure to cutting-edge ideas across AI, scientific discovery, and emerging technologies

title: Social Media Manager
description:
As a Social Media Manager at vCluster, you aren't just scheduling posts-you are building the technical voice of one of the most interesting infrastructure companies in the cloud-native ecosystem. You will own the full social program across LinkedIn and X, turn the thinking of our leaders into content the Kubernetes community actually wants to read, and show up live at the events that matter most to our audience.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Content Calendar Ownership: Plan, write, and publish weekly posts on LinkedIn and X. Stay two weeks ahead at all times. No gaps, no scramble.

- Executive Thought Leadership Extraction: Turn the deep architectural insights of our leadership team into high-impact published content and thought leadership.

- Community Management: Respond thoughtfully to comments, DMs, and mentions on both platforms. Engage with practitioners, contributors, and platform engineering leaders-adding real value to the infrastructure conversation, not just reacting.

- Reactive Distribution: When something happens in the cloud-native and AI infra world-a major CNCF release, an architectural debate, a KubeCon announcement-you move fast to capture attention while the narrative has a short half-life.

- Live Event Coverage: Cover priority global events (such as KubeCon and key AI Infra summits) in real time-delivering live threads on X, daily LinkedIn updates, and post-event structural recaps.

- Editorial Quality Bar: Act as the standard-bearer for what goes out under our brand name. You will be expected to ruthlessly protect our brand voice, push back on subpar content, and actively propose higher-impact alternatives.

THIS ROLE IS A FIT FOR YOU IF:

- Infrastructure Literacy: You don't need to be a Kubernetes kernel engineer, but you must be "infrastructure-literate." You understand the landscape well enough to write credibly for DevOps and platform teams.

- Platform Mastery: You have an opinionated view on how to win on LinkedIn and X. You can point directly to developer-centric or highly technical social accounts you have personally scaled and grown.

- Calendar Discipline: You operate with a clear structural framework. You build and own a structured content calendar without being asked, maintaining a two-week safety buffer by default.

- Speed and Judgment: You balance high-velocity output with corporate judgment. You know exactly when to capitalize on an infrastructure trend instantly and when a narrative requires strict message alignment first.

- Analytical Rigor: You measure social success by its ability to spark genuine community conversation, traffic, and distribution momentum-not just empty vanity metrics.

BONUS POINTS FOR:

- Infrastructure Roots: Background managing social channels for developer tools, open-source ecosystems, or AI/MLOps infrastructure.

- Executive Ghost-Writing: Direct experience translating deep technical expertise from executives into compelling, human narratives.

- Multimedia Capability: Basic video clip selection and editing skills to transform live product demos or executive sessions into high-engagement social cuts.

- On-Site Autonomy: Comfort being on-the-ground at massive industry events, executing a live social playbook entirely independently.

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

Group Financial Strategy & Planning

• Set the financial strategy for the Group, aligned to Modaxo 's financial policies.

• Lead annual budgeting, quarterly forecasting and long-range financial planning across all four businesses.

• Support the Portfolio CFO on acquisition due diligence and lead the financial integration of newly acquired businesses into the Group - evaluating and hiring finance resource, migrating finance systems and processes, and educating acquired management teams on Group KPIs and finance requirements.

title: Senior Manager, Collector Loyalty
description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. 

 

About the Company
Fanatics Collect is a global product and technology group dedicated to revolutionizing the world of collectibles. Every single day our team of experienced product leaders, engineers, and operators obsesses over how to create the ultimate collector experience with our products: Topps.com, the direct to consumer ecommerce platform of the Topps brand, Fanatics Collect, the most trusted and dynamic collector focused marketplace, and our collector focused live shopping platforms, Fanatics Live and Voggt.

We have the unique advantage of being backed by Fanatics - the world’s largest sports merchandiser, with more than 900 global sports relationships, 90+ million reachable fans, and exclusive licensing deals with the MLB, NFL, and NBA among many others - but we’re a nimble, ambitious team building products from the ground up.

If you're passionate about building world class products and share our love for sports fans and collectors, Fanatics Collect offers an exciting opportunity to be part of a dynamic team creating the future of collecting.

About the Role
Fanatics Collect is seeking a Senior Manager, Collector Loyalty to lead the go-to-market strategy and collector experience for Fanatics ONE and FanCash across Fanatics Live, Fanatics Collect, and Topps. This role sits at the intersection of Growth, Product, Marketing, and Analytics, translating enterprise loyalty initiatives into clear, scalable programs that drive adoption, engagement, retention, and long-term customer value.

The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with operational excellence and possesses a deep understanding of loyalty ecosystems, customer journeys, and go-to-market execution. You will partner across multiple business units to ensure Fanatics ONE delivers a cohesive, differentiated, and compelling experience for collectors while supporting measurable business outcomes.

Responsibilities

• Develop and execute loyalty go-to-market strategies for Fanatics ONE and FanCash across Fanatics Live, Fanatics Collect, and Topps.

• Own all loyalty go-to-market campaigns and initiatives across TLC (Topps, Fanatics Live, and Fanatics Collect), serving as the central point of accountability from strategy through execution.

title: Head of Finance Automation/ AI Agentification
description:
Finance at Rohlik is being rebuilt to run on AI. We already have agents in production that chase overdue payments, process invoices, allocate cash and clear the team's inbox. The pieces work. What we need now is one person to own the whole thing and make it deliver at scale.

 

ROLE OVERVIEW

This is a new role that owns how AI and automation reshape the finance operating model across the Group. You will take a programme that is already live across procure to pay, order to cash and our shared services centre, and turn it from a set of promising experiments into the way finance actually runs.

You report to the Group CFO. You inherit a small team and a live roadmap, and you own the result. You decide what gets automated first, you build and ship with AI tools when that is the fastest way, and you hold every workstream to a number.

The role is deliberately hands on. You should be close enough to the work to build an agent or connect two systems through an API with AI assistance, even though you are not a software developer. You should also be senior enough to redesign how finance works and bring the rest of the business with you.

 

WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING

- You’ll inherit a live AI programme with real agents, real data and real impact from day one - not a greenfield slide deck.

- You’ll shape how Finance actually runs across the Group as we move toward the next stage of growth - including the journey toward IPO readiness.

- You’ll have access to a top-notch AI-first tech stack and the freedom to use it pragmatically.

- You’ll work directly with the Group CFO, with fast decisions and no corporate red tape.

- Your good ideas will be implemented almost immediately - not parked in a roadmap waiting for HQ approval.

- You’ll lead a small team, but this is not a “manager from a distance” role. It’s highly hands-on, high-impact, and built for someone who wants to make things move fast.

 

WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU

- Own the AI and automation agenda across finance, from strategy through delivery to measured impact.

- Lead process redesign the right way: map and understand the as-is, then design an agentic-first to-be rather than automating the old steps.

- Lead complex cross-functional programmes across Finance, Tech and Operations, driving delivery through stakeholders and teams beyond your direct reporting line.

- Bring the live programme to its targets, with a clear owner, baseline and deadline behind every workstream.

- Redesign core finance processes around AI and agents, starting with close, reporting and forecasting.

- Build and ship yourself when it is faster, using AI assisted tools to create agents and connect systems such as NetSuite, Rossum and n8n.

- Lead and grow the team (three today) and raise AI fluency across finance and the SSC so the business can use what you build.

- Track what matters and report it straight: automation rate, close time, cash allocation speed, cost and effort taken out.

- Roll out across our five markets, balancing local reality against one Group standard.

 

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

You have probably spent time in strategy consulting or in a transformation role, and you are now genuinely excited by what AI can do. You are a sharp generalist who can walk into a messy process, find the real problem, and fix it. You are as comfortable in a CFO pre-read as you are in the AI first tool building the thing.

- A track record of leading transformation or automation programmes that actually delivered. A consulting, operations or generalist operator background all fit.

- Strong understanding of finance processes, ideally gained through finance transformation, operating model redesign or automation programmes.

- Hands on with AI. You can build agents and integrate APIs with AI assistance. You are not a software engineer and you do not need to be, but the tooling does not scare you.

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Ads Bidding
description:
STAFF MACHINE LEARNING ENGINEER - ADS BIDDING

THE TEAM

The Ads ML team builds and maintains the machine learning models powering Deliveroo's advertising product - connecting consumers with relevant ads and helping merchants, grocers, and FMCG brands grow through the platform. The UK team is ~11 MLEs across ads and promotions, and collaborates closely with the US team (meetings capped at 4pm UK to protect reasonable hours).

THE PROBLEM

Deliveroo is migrating ads from cost-per-click (CPC) to cost-per-order (CPO) - merchants pay when an ad drives an order, not when it's clicked. This is a genuinely open, cutting-edge problem: very few companies have solved it, and there's no established playbook to follow. The exact approach is under active discussion and you'd be central to driving it.

YOU WILL:

- Own the design and execution of the CPC-to-CPO migration, including the core open question of whether the system stays CPO-facing externally while optimising CPC behind the scenes, or some hybrid of the two

- Build and improve the bidding surface: goal-based automated bidding, Target CPO, optimised CPC, and Target ROAS

- Own yield management tied to ROS targeting

- Partner daily with the DoorDash US team to align on approach across markets

- Set technical direction for the domain

REQUIREMENTS

- Expertise in ad economics, marketplace bidding, or auction theory

- Direct working experience with optimised CPC, target CPO, goal-based automated bidding, and target ROAS

- Strong self-driven leadership baseline - you'll be setting direction in an ambiguous space, not executing against an established one

- 7+ years writing production code in Python; solid ML fundamentals in ranking, recommendation systems, or bidding/auction systems

- A bias for simplicity and a focus on shipping work with measurable business impact

- Strong cross-functional communication - you'll be working closely with Product, Commercial, and the wider DoorDash team

WHY JOIN US?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters-solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create
Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

OUR GLOBAL STRUCTURE

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About MonetizeMore
MonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally. We combine proprietary technology with sophisticated optimization strategies to secure and maximize publisher revenue. We are a 100% remote, culture-first organization driven by four core values: Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen (Continuous Improvement), and Collaboration . We empower our global team with absolute location autonomy and flexible global schedules. We care about the impact you deliver, not the hours you log on.
About the Role
The company is seeking an experienced, systems-driven Business Operations Manager to transform informal workflows into owned, structured, and scalable operational systems. As the primary connective layer across departments, this role focuses on process kaizen, SOP governance, and end-to-end operational enablement-ensuring teams execute efficiently without reinventing processes.

The Business Operations Manager will manage the central project management infrastructure and partner directly with Product and executive leadership. Key responsibilities include preparing cross-functional teams for product launches, streamlining enterprise client workflows, and establishing organization-wide standards for accountability and visibility. As a data- and AI-fluent operator, the candidate will design structured spreadsheet models, integrate AI tools to accelerate documentation, and continuously optimize reporting systems.
Core Responsibilities
1. Process Kaizen & SOP Governance

• Run a continuous improvement cadence across the process landscape; killing, combining, or improving SOPs weekly. Own the process vault and ensure every process is signed off by its owner and governed for adoption, not just documented.

2. Project Management & Visibility

• Own and maintain BE's project management tracker; ensuring all projects, to-dos, and tickets are tracked, visible, and actioned. Drive adoption beyond BE, building the foundation for a company-wide model with long-term integration into BL L10s.

3. Product Rollout Support

• Support product release processes, structuring the operational side of launches so teams are enabled ahead of go-live. Work closely with the incoming Group PM to formalize this process as a repeatable model.

4. Cross-Departmental & Enterprise Client Enablement

• Act as an operational connective layer across business lines and enterprise client workflows; surfacing blockers, coordinating data and documentation needs, and keeping cross-functional commitments visible and actioned.

5. Data & Spreadsheet Management

• Own data pulls and spreadsheet-based reporting for BE initiatives; Building and maintaining structured, reliable models that others can use without re-deriving logic. Comfort with formulas, structured data, and dashboard hygiene is core to the role, not incidental.

Who You Are

•
The Experienced Operator: You have 4+ years of experience in a process, project management, or business operations role. Ad tech, SaaS, high-data-volume or WordPress ecosystem experience is a plus, as is experience working with Salesforce (SFDC).

•
The Systems Builder: You default to structure, and you know the difference between owning a process and doing the work inside it. Given a messy or untracked workstream, your instinct is to define ownership, standardize steps, and build the scaffolding (trackers, SOPs, cadences) that lets other functions execute reliably.

•
Data- and AI-Fluent: You're comfortable pulling, cleaning, and structuring data in spreadsheets without hand-holding, and you've used AI tools in your actual workflow to speed up documentation and process work.

•
Comfortable with Ambiguity: You can walk into an undefined workstream, ask the right questions, and leave it with clear ownership and a repeatable process.

•
Direct Communicator: You flag problems early and plainly. You don't let a stalled ticket or an unsigned SOP sit quietly.

About the Role
 
As a Treasury Professional, you manage and optimize daily cash operations to ensure financial efficiency and stability across the organization. You provide cash flow reporting, execute timely payments, and handle bank transfers and reconciliations. Collaborating closely with finance, technology, and banking partners, you ensure seamless integration of POS systems and accurate settlement of merchant transactions. By understanding funding and interchange structures, you help shape competitive pricing strategies and negotiate favorable terms with banks. You also play a key role in financial reporting, closing activities, and automating treasury processes through tools like SAP. Your work supports broader digital payment initiatives and enhances payment excellence across the business.

What We Offer
A hybrid working model with flexibility - a schedule that helps you find the right balance between flexibility and team bonding, including work-from-abroad opportunities and a summer working model.
A customizable FlexBenefits budget - Adjust your daily meal allowance, choose your health insurance package (and extend it to your spouse or children), and pick from additional benefits like fuel support or Trendyol shopping credits.
Comprehensive wellbeing support - Take advantage of our extended health package, which includes annual mini health screenings, access to location-based in-house doctors, psychologist and dietitian support, and HPV vaccination coverage.
Personalized training allowance and learning opportunities - Use your annual budget for any training or conference of your choice, explore our Learning Management System (LMS) anytime, and join in-person learning sessions offered throughout the year.
Responsibility from day one - Take full ownership from the start in a culture where every voice is heard and valued.
A diverse, international team - Collaborate with global peers across our offices in Berlin, Amsterdam, Dubai, and beyond, in a startup-spirited and collaborative environment.
Opportunities to grow with the best - Tackle meaningful challenges, develop through hands-on experience, and grow with the support of expert guidance and global mentoring.
Meaningful connections beyond tasks - Be part of team rituals, events, and social activities that help us stay connected and inspired.
 
 
Take the Next Step
If this role excites you, apply now and let’s take the next step together.
Want to get to know the team better first? Explore our Career Website, LinkedIn, or YouTube to learn more about #LifeatTrendyol and how we work.

title: Outbound Caller — Appointment Setter
description:
Outbound Caller - Appointment Setter
Lend Home Improvements (LHI)
[Remote / City, ST] • Hourly + Appointment Bonus
About LHI
Lend Home Improvements gives home improvement contractors the financing infrastructure they need to close more jobs. We connect contractors with the right lenders, get them set up fast, and stay in their corner as they grow. No jargon, no runaround - just practical tools that help contractors offer their customers payment options and win more work.
The Role
We’re hiring an Outbound Caller to set appointments for our sales team. You’ll work through a steady queue of home improvement contractors, introduce LHI, and book demos on our Account Executives’ calendars. This is a high-activity, phone-first role for someone who’s comfortable dialing, confident on the phone, and motivated to hit a daily number.
You won’t be cold-calling into the void - you’ll work from provided lead lists, with scripts, training, and a CRM that keeps your day organized.

This is a remote position; however, candidates must currently reside in Michigan or Ohio.
What You’ll Do

• Make a high volume of outbound calls to home improvement contractors from provided lead lists

• Introduce LHI clearly and confidently, and gauge each contractor’s interest

• Book qualified appointments on the sales team’s calendars

• Log every call and appointment accurately in HubSpot

• Hit weekly goals for conversations held and appointments set

What We’re Looking For

• Previous outbound calling, appointment-setting, telemarketing, or phone sales experience preferred

• A clear, confident, friendly phone presence

• Comfort with high call volume and a consistent daily rhythm

• Organized and reliable - you log your work and keep the calendar full

• Coachable and open to feedback

• Comfortable working in a CRM (HubSpot experience is a plus)

• Self-motivated and dependable, especially in a remote setting

• Bonus points for experience in home improvement, contracting, home services, or financing

Compensation

• Hourly base pay - $20

• Originator bonus - earn a bonus for every qualified appointment that the prospect attends

You’re rewarded for appointments that actually happen - so the focus is on booking real, interested contractors who show up.
Tools & Support
• HubSpot CRM with lead lists ready for you
• Scripts, training, and coaching from day one

title: Online Marketing Manager (Mensch)
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

WPP steht für kreative Transformation. Mit der Kraft von Kreativität gestalten wir eine bessere Zukunft für unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Kunden, unsere Gemeinschaften und unseren Planeten. Genau hier setzt WPP Media an: Als globales Mediennetzwerk von WPP vereinen wir die besten Plattformen, Talente und Partner, um in einer vernetzten Medienwelt neue Chancen für grenzenloses Wachstum zu schaffen.

Das bieten wir dir:

• Work-Life-Balance : Dank flexibler Arbeitszeiten mit Schwerpunkt auf dem persönlichen Austausch im Office und ergänzender Remote Work passt sich dein Job deinem Leben an. Überstunden kannst du flexible ausgleichen.

• Vacation mode on : Du erhältst 30 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag - zusätzlich sind der 24. und 31.12. frei.

• Wellbeing first:  Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.

• Practice makes perfect : Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP-Netzwerk.

• More than just a job : Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.

• Be yourself : Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen.

Das bewegst du:

Als Online Marketing Manager (Mensch) bist du verantwortlich für die Planung und Umsetzung digitaler Kampagnen und entwickelst auf Basis von Markt- und Nutzungsentwicklungen passgenaue Empfehlungen für unsere Kunden.

• Digitale Maßnahmenplanung:  Du verantwortest die Umsetzung digitaler Maßnahmen von der Planung bis zur Finalisierung. Dabei denkst du holistisch und stimmst dich eng mit unseren Kanalexperten zu Paid Search, Paid Social, Programmatic und E-Commerce ab.

• Markt- & Medienbeobachtung:  Anhand von Analysen der   Mediennutzung und Markttrends leitest du Handlungsempfehlungen für Platzierungen, Formate und Targetings ab.

• Stakeholder-Management:  Kontinuierlich bist du im Austausch mit Beratung, Vermarktern, Channel-Experten und dem Campaign Management.

• Angebotsmanagement:  Angebote, Kooperationen und Sonderwerbeformen werden von dir bei Vermarktern angefragt und bewertet. 

• Konditionssteuerung:  Durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Investment Team gewährleistest du die besten Konditionen für unsere Kunden. 

• Forecast & Budgetverteilung:  Über einen detaillierten Jahres-Forecast planst du die Verteilung des Digitalbudgets. 

Das zeichnet dich aus:

• Ausbildung:  Ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine Ausbildung in Marketing, Medien, Wirtschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich bringst du mit.

• Berufserfahrung:  Du verfügst über 1-2 Jahre Erfahrung in der digitalen Beratung oder Planung - auf Seiten des Kunden, der Agentur oder des Vermarkters.

• Fachkenntnisse:  Sicherer Umgang mit gängigen Planungstools sowie Verständnis relevanter Online-KPIs sind für dich selbstverständlich.

• Tools & Zahlenaffinität:  Gute Excel-Kenntnisse, Spaß an Zahlen und ein analytisches Verständnis bringst du mit.

title: Influencer Program Lead - LATAM
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s LATAM Marketing team helps people understand how AI can benefit their lives and put that value into practice. We connect global product innovation with local consumer needs, culture and behavior across Brazil and Spanish-speaking Latin America, contributing to OpenAI’s mission of ensuring that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity.

We bring together strategy and creativity across integrated campaigns, product launches, creators, social, partnerships and cultural experiences. Working with global and local cross-functional teams, we make AI’s everyday usefulness tangible and relevant to people across the region.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Influencer Program Lead to own influencer marketing across Brazil and Spanish Speaking LATAM, from strategy and creator selection through briefing, delivery and measurement. The role also owns the marketing side of partnerships, connecting partner audiences and channels with clear product value and locally relevant campaigns.

You will turn consumer insight and product understanding into creator programs and partnership activations that help people discover useful applications of ChatGPT, build confidence in new capabilities and use them more often. You should be as comfortable shaping a brief and reviewing content as coordinating creators, agencies, partners and global teams. This role is based in Brazil; São Paulo, hybrid model.

In this role, you will:

- Own the influencer strategy and program calendar for Brazil and Spanish Speaking LATAM, using audience insight to define objectives, creator roles and a sustainable mix of always-on education and campaign activity.

- Select, brief and manage creators and agencies based on audience fit, credibility, content quality and cultural relevance; build relationships that support consistent, useful storytelling.

- Translate product features and AI capabilities into clear creator briefs, demonstrations and content, with accurate expectations about product behavior and limitations.

- Turn product launches and cultural moments into creator-led campaigns, coordinating content distribution and reuse with owned social, Growth and integrated marketing teams.

- Support professional-use creator education, aligning with B2B marketing on use cases, audience needs and learning objectives.

- Own partnership marketing plans: connect partner audience insights with product use cases, shape co-marketing narratives and briefs, and coordinate creative assets, channel activation and launch readiness.

- Partner with Partnerships, Product Marketing, Growth, Brand, Creative, Production, Comms and Legal to align objectives, messaging, approvals and delivery across creator and partnership programs.

- Define success and learning plans before launch, using relevant brand and behavioral metrics and experimentation where feasible; use results to improve creator selection, content and resource allocation.

What you bring

- Proven experience leading marketing programs from strategy through hands-on execution, with knowledge of creator ecosystems in LATAM.

- Deep local market knowledge and an insight-first approach, with sound judgment on creator fit, content quality and cultural relevance.

- Strong product storytelling skills and genuine product curiosity. You explore AI tools yourself and can turn complex capabilities into useful, credible consumer stories.

title: Account Executive, North America
description:
ABOUT ROOTSTOCK

Rootstock Software is a leading provider of native Cloud ERP on the Salesforce Platform. We empower manufacturing, distribution, and supply chain organizations to digitally transform their operations by delivering flexible, modern, and scalable ERP solutions. Our customers include some of the most innovative product-central companies across North America. We are the only ERP built natively on Salesforce, which means our customers run operations and CRM on one cloud platform rather than stitching a legacy ERP to their front office.

This is a remote position, based in the United States or Canada.
Please, no agencies/recruiters.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a high-performing Account Executive to drive new business across North America. In this individual contributor role you will own the full sales cycle, targeting mid-market to large enterprise companies in manufacturing, distribution, and supply chain. The role rewards a consultative, strategic seller who is comfortable teaching a buyer something they did not know and controlling a complex, multi-stakeholder evaluation. This is not a transactional product. Our buyers require education, business case development, and clear platform differentiation. We win by leading with insight.

DEAL PROFILE

• Buying committee spans operations, IT, and finance, up to C-level

• Competitive set is legacy and disconnected ERP, most often displaced by showing a unified operations and CRM platform

TERRITORY AND SUPPORT

• A named territory of high-priority, best-fit accounts, typically $50M to $500M in revenue

• A dedicated New Logo Hunting SDR partnered to your territory to accelerate outbound pipeline generation. While the SDR supports you, you are expected to independently source pipeline and proactively hunt new logo opportunities.

• Drive net new customer acquisition across your named territory

• Deliver tailored product demos, proposals, and business cases aligned to client needs

• Navigate multi-stakeholder buying processes in complex enterprise environments

• Build and execute a territory plan that generates meaningful self-sourced pipeline. Own pipeline creation alongside your dedicated SDR through strategic outbound prospecting, account-based hunting, networking, partner engagement, and executive outreach.

• Partner with your SDR and Solutions Consultant to create and advance opportunities

• Collaborate with pre-sales, implementation teams, and Salesforce ecosystem partners

• Forecast accurately and manage your number with discipline

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• 5 to 10+ years of enterprise software sales experience, ideally B2B SaaS

• Proven success in complex B2B sales with deal values in the $50K to $500K+ range

• Solid understanding of manufacturing and supply chain operations

• Strong business acumen, with experience engaging IT, operations, and finance

• Ability to build executive relationships and close multi-stakeholder deals

• A self-motivated, results-driven professional with a consistent record of exceeding quota

• A true hunter who self-sources pipeline and does not wait for leads to be handed over

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills

• Familiarity with Salesforce-native or integrated ERP environments is a plus

• Existing relationships with Salesforce account teams or ecosystem partners are a strong advantage

title: Remote National Medical Director
description:
Position Purpose:
Assist the Chief Medical Director to direct and coordinate the medical management, quality improvement and credentialing functions for the business unit.

• Provides medical leadership of all for utilization management, cost containment, and medical quality improvement activities.

• Performs medical review activities pertaining to utilization review, quality assurance, and medical review of complex, controversial, or experimental medical services, ensuring timely and quality decision making.

• Supports effective implementation of performance improvement initiatives for capitated providers.

• Assists Chief Medical Director in planning and establishing goals and policies to improve quality and cost-effectiveness of care and service for members.

• Provides medical expertise in the operation of approved quality improvement and utilization management programs in accordance with regulatory, state, corporate, and accreditation requirements.

• Assists the Chief Medical Director in the functioning of the physician committees including committee structure, processes, and membership.

• Conduct regular rounds to assess and coordinate care for high-risk patients, collaborating with care management teams to optimize outcomes.

• Collaborates effectively with clinical teams, network providers, appeals team, medical and pharmacy consultants for reviewing complex cases and medical necessity appeals.

• Participates in provider network development and new market expansion as appropriate.

• Assists in the development and implementation of physician education with respect to clinical issues and policies.

• Identifies utilization review studies and evaluates adverse trends in utilization of medical services, unusual provider practice patterns, and adequacy of benefit/payment components.

• Identifies clinical quality improvement studies to assist in reducing unwarranted variation in clinical practice in order to improve the quality and cost of care.

• Interfaces with physicians and other providers in order to facilitate implementation of recommendations to providers that would improve utilization and health care quality.

• Reviews claims involving complex, controversial, or unusual or new services in order to determine medical necessity and appropriate payment.

• Develops alliances with the provider community through the development and implementation of the medical management programs.

• As needed, may represent the business unit before various publics both locally and nationally on medical philosophy, policies, and related issues.

• Represents the business unit at appropriate state committees and other ad hoc committees.

• May be required to work weekends and holidays in support of business operations, as needed.

• Medical Doctor or Doctor of Osteopathy.

• Utilization Management experience and knowledge of quality accreditation standards preferred.

• Actively practices medicine.

• Course work in the areas of Health Administration, Health Financing, Insurance, and/or Personnel Management is advantageous.

• Experience treating or managing care for a culturally diverse population preferred.

License/Certifications:

• Board certification in a medical specialty recognized by the American Board of Medical Specialists or the American Osteopathic Association’s Department of Certifying Board Services.

• Active Certification in Internal or Family Medicine, preferred.

• Current state license as a MD or DO without restrictions, limitations, or sanctions from government programs.
